dataset.identity: UCI Optical Recognition of Handwritten Digits official fixed split
dataset.partition_statement: UCI states that 30 people contributed to training and a different 13 to test; the fixed test set is the writer-independent quality measure.

experimental_unit: exact-feature group in the fixed writer-independent test partition after averaging repeat and declared-noise observations within group

model.prototype_fit: deterministic farthest-first on the official training partition only

inference.multiplicity: Holm adjustment across three accuracy hypotheses
inference.unit: exact-feature group in fixed test partition
inference.estimand: unweighted mean across exact-feature groups; repeat and declared-noise observations are averaged inside each group
inference.limitation: writer identities within the 13-writer test partition are unavailable, so intervals do not account for within-writer clustering

hypotheses.contrast: anchor_topk minus direct_multi averaged across declared noise levels
hypotheses.decision: effect >= 0.01, lower 95% paired bootstrap bound > 0, Holm-adjusted one-sided permutation p < 0.05
effect >= 0.01, lower 95% paired bootstrap bound > 0, Holm-adjusted one-sided permutation p < 0.05

hypotheses.contrast: anchor_topk minus fixed logistic regression averaged across declared noise levels
hypotheses.decision: effect >= -0.01, lower 95% paired bootstrap bound > -0.01, and Holm-adjusted one-sided permutation p against the -0.01 margin < 0.05

hypotheses.contrast: original_topk minus anchor_topk mean state displacement
hypotheses.decision: effect >= 0.1 and lower 95% paired bootstrap bound > 0.1

negative_control.design: 20 deterministic training-label permutations evaluated on the fixed writer-independent test partition at zero noise with anchor_topk

hardware.required: CUDA GPU with at least 8 GiB total memory

claim_boundary: Writer-disjoint partition confirmation on the official UCI split. It is not writer-cluster-adjusted inference, independent reproduction, SOTA evidence, or unrestricted efficacy evidence.
